scope: Local scenario/control design history, not agent-trial results.
selection: Deterministic bounded scenario grids retained in full; no post-hoc selection on target-model outcomes. First local runs used development controls and identified infrastructure setup defects. Scenario generator bytes below were frozen before adding the four validation-bank controls.
developmentControls: Every non-post-selection control in each retained manifest is a development/regression control, not held out.
qualification: The four new controls were not used to choose scenario membership. After their first inspected results they become regression evidence, not a perpetually unseen bank. Any resulting repair must be recorded in the Prompt 4 verification report.
